verified_facts: the EA LIDAR Composite DTM is a 1m raster elevation model
it covers about 99 percent of England
surface objects are removed to produce a terrain surface
the composite uses time-stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme surveys
the 2022 composite survey period is 6 June 2000 to 2 April 2022
heights are metres referenced to Ordnance Survey Newlyn
individual source surveys have vertical accuracy plus or minus 15cm RMSE
quality_effect: Pins the primary EA terrain surface, spatial reference, period and vertical-accuracy contract.
